_doc: Format of ONE trait in facts.json. Part A is filled by scripts/facts.py before the agent starts. Part B is filled by the agent after it probes the seller folder. The stop gate checks Part B.

A_script.rule: small < 40 L; mid 40 L-5 Cr; large > 5 Cr; one step up if seller AOV > 2 x category AOV

B_agent.note: what the agent learned in the files that the number does not show
B_agent.implication_for_persona: e.g. plain, practical tone; small-ticket examples
